input.description: A single smartphone-captured photo of a collapsible outdoor water bottle, taken at an office desk. Lighting is adequate but the background is cluttered (desk reflections, a nearby pen holder, a monitor visible in the distance) and conveys no 'outdoor' context.

workflow_steps.step_description: The raw, unedited office-desk phone photo of the product is uploaded into the Meitu Design Studio tool as the starting asset.
workflow_steps.input: Raw smartphone product photo (cluttered background, adequate lighting)
workflow_steps.output: Ingested source image ready for AI processing
workflow_steps.professional_rule: Professional studio photography is not required as input; a phone photo with a clear subject and correct angle is sufficient starting material.

workflow_steps.step_name: 核心指令 (Core instructions / selling-point input)
workflow_steps.step_description: The user inputs specific product selling points as text instructions: 'food-grade silicone folding structure, lightweight design, outdoor carabiner/clip system.' Each phrase is chosen to map to a specific consumer concern (food-grade -> safety; lightweight -> hiking pain point; carabiner system -> functional differentiation from competitors).
workflow_steps.input: Ingested source image + product attribute knowledge
workflow_steps.action: Enter selling-point text prompts mapped to consumer benefit framing
workflow_steps.output: Structured selling-point instructions attached to the image-generation job
workflow_steps.professional_rule: Raw product attributes should be translated into consumer-facing benefit language before generation, not passed through as raw specs.

workflow_steps.step_description: One of four defined visual-direction styles is selected: outdoor vitality, tech quality, home casual, or luxury. For this product, 'outdoor vitality' was chosen because it was reported to produce higher click-through rates for this product category.
workflow_steps.action: Select a style direction from four defined options based on category/audience fit
workflow_steps.output: Chosen visual style direction (outdoor vitality) applied to subsequent generation
workflow_steps.professional_rule: Style selection should be driven by category-level performance data (e.g., CTR by style) rather than aesthetic preference alone.

workflow_steps.step_description: Using 'smart matching' or 'custom configuration' mode, a minimum 7-image suite is generated spanning four required categories: white-background shots (folded and unfolded states), scene images (kitchen counter, backpack side pocket), selling-point close-ups (material texture, carabiner detail), and a system-recommended fold/unfold comparison image.
workflow_steps.input: Chosen style direction + selling-point instructions + source image
workflow_steps.action: Generate multi-category image suite via AI tool (smart matching or custom configuration)
workflow_steps.output: A minimum 7-image suite covering white-background, scene, selling-point, and comparison categories
workflow_steps.professional_rule: A Tmall-style detail page requires a minimum of 7 images across 4 categories for adequate information density; a white-background image is mandatory for platform norms; product body should occupy >=60% of frame composition; images should use a 3:4 vertical ratio to maximize mobile screen space.

workflow_steps.step_name: 生成与落位 (Generation and page placement)
workflow_steps.step_description: The final high-quality image assets are rendered and placed into the existing detail-page layout/framework to produce the finished page.
workflow_steps.action: Render final assets and integrate into detail-page layout
workflow_steps.output: Completed Tmall product detail page with unified visual style

final_outputs: A stylistically unified set of at least 7 product images meeting stated platform composition norms (mandatory white-background shot, >=60% product-body composition, 3:4 vertical ratio)
A finished Tmall product detail page assembled from the generated image suite
professional_constraints: Minimum 7 images required for adequate information density on a Tmall detail page
4 required image-type categories: white-background, scene, selling-point close-up, comparison
White-background image is a mandatory inclusion
Product body should occupy 60% or more of image composition
3:4 vertical image ratio recommended to maximize mobile-screen utilization
Selling points should be translated into consumer benefit language, not listed as raw specs
Style direction should be chosen based on category-level click-through-rate performance
production_or_delivery_requirements: Minimum 7-image suite spanning 4 defined categories before a page is considered complete
3:4 vertical aspect ratio for mobile optimization
source_limitations: Vendor tutorial content published by Meitu to promote its own AI Design Studio product; not independently authored or third-party audited

No external/independent outcome metric (e.g. actual sales lift) provided; only a self-reported internal efficiency claim ('2 designer-days -> under 30 minutes') and an unmethodologized CTR claim for style selection
Single worked example (one folding water bottle); illustrative of intended tool workflow rather than an audited independent commercial project
No detail on photography equipment/settings beyond 'phone camera, adequate lighting'
No timing information for the human decision steps (selling-point entry, style choice), only for the automated generation step
